extracted.intended_audience: Researchers/authors submitting to ACS journals (corresponding authors), librarians and research administrators
extracted.subtask_short: zero-embargo green open access for ACS authors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for ACS authors who wish to immediately make their accepted manuscript publicly available (zero-embargo green OA), including when an Article Development Charge (ADC) applies, how to opt in, eligibility, waivers, and differences between accepted manuscripts and the version of record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article Development Charge (ADC) applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: The ADC is due only after acceptance and before publication. It is not a submission or deposit fee. It is only applicable to authors who choose the zero-embargo green OA option.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ADC affords broad sharing capabilities for the accepted manuscript by any means and is directly proportional to the cost of publishing services provided up to acceptance. Authors publishing under an ACS institutional open access agreement will never need to pay the ADC. The ADC may be an allowable publication cost under many grants; authors should confirm with their funder.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADC amount and pricing reference
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ADC is $2,500. More information can be found on ACS' pricing page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: ACS hybrid journals only
rubrics_metrics.description: The ADC is only an option when publishing in ACS hybrid journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The version of record for all articles published in ACS fully open access journals are made immediately open access upon publication; ADC does not apply to fully OA journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Triggering the zero-embargo green OA process
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors who note in their cover letter or manuscript that they want to immediately post the accepted manuscript will trigger the process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the funder's standard language regarding immediate self-archiving is included with the manuscript at submission, it will automatically trigger the zero-embargo green OA process. The OA Operations team will contact the submitting corresponding author to confirm next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditions for ADC being applied to a submission
rubrics_metrics.description: The ADC will apply only when authors have included their research funder’s standard language regarding immediate self-archiving of the accepted manuscript, and where the submitting corresponding author does not indicate that they wish to publish the version of record as open access (e.g., under an institutional open access agreement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the corresponding author is affiliated with an institution that has an active open access agreement with ACS, or indicates they have funding to make the version of record open access, the ADC will not be applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Waiver and discount eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: ADC waivers or discounts for authors from certain countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ADC waivers or discounts will be automatically applied when the corresponding author originates from a country that currently receives special country pricing for article publishing charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADC credit toward later APC (offset policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: If an author pays the ADC but later decides to publish the version of record as open access, the ADC will be credited toward the article publishing charge (APC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: if list APC is $4,500 and ADC of $2,500 has been paid, the APC will be reduced to $2,000.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADC covers pre-publication services (scope of coverage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The ADC covers the cost of ACS’ publishing services through final editorial decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services covered include organizing and maintaining a high-quality scholarly peer review process, technology and systems for secure manuscript submission and peer review management, initial vetting, data verification, fraud detection, multi-expert peer review, and related editorial development activities. The ADC is directly proportional to and covers these pre-publication costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADC does not cover final production and version-of-record services
rubrics_metrics.description: Unlike an APC, the ADC does not cover expenses related to final production, digital distribution, discovery, hosting of the version of record, or maintaining post-publication updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Features that make articles discoverable (professional formatting, metadata tagging, indexing, multi-format distribution, long-term preservation, promotion, usage and citation statistics, etc.) are added during the final phase of publication and are not funded by the ADC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Differences between accepted manuscript and version of record
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepted manuscript includes all changes made through the editorial development process; the version of record includes additional professional enhancements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepted manuscript: incorporates peer review feedback and basic formatting per submission requirements. Version of record enhancements include professional formatting, image support, technical edits, metadata tagging for discovery, digital linking, maintenance (retractions/corrections), multi-format distribution, enhanced discovery (indexing with CAS and search engines), long-term preservation with Portico, maintenance of reference links, hosting of supporting materials, usage and citation statistics, and promotion. These enhancements make the version of record more discoverable and definitive.

rubrics_metrics.name: DOI assignment for accepted manuscripts under zero-embargo
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepted manuscripts published under the zero-embargo green OA option will be issued with a DOI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The DOI is registered upon acceptance and will become active when the final version of record is published in an ACS journal. The DOI will resolve to the version of record.

rubrics_metrics.name: When payment is due and payment options
rubrics_metrics.description: Timing and acceptance of ADC payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article development charge is due after the manuscript is accepted but before publication. Early payments are also accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who must comply with zero-embargo green OA mandates
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance depends on research funder or institutional policy; authors must confirm obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many governments and funders (e.g., US OSTP guidance) are adopting zero-embargo requirements. An author’s research funder is the most reliable source of information; applicable policies will be available on a funder’s website or in grant terms. If neither the funder nor institution has a zero-embargo policy, the author does not need to pay an ADC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opt-in mechanism and author responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: How authors opt in and what they should include to invoke the option.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funders who require immediate posting usually recommend that standard language is included in the manuscript or cover letter. Including this documentation at submission triggers the zero-embargo process; OA Operations will then contact the corresponding author to confirm next steps. Authors should check with their funder about whether ADC is an allowable grant expense before choosing this option.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of benefit comparison across OA pathways
rubrics_metrics.description: How zero-embargo green OA fits among other OA pathways and what benefits each pathway provides.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Zero-embargo green OA is a lower-cost middle ground for authors not covered by institutional OA agreements and who need immediate OA. It allows posting the accepted manuscript immediately but does not provide version-of-record benefits. Gold OA (via APC or institutional agreement) makes the version of record immediately available and covers final production/distribution/discovery/hosting.
